title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1986-04-04
lineage: Nak DR-10 (Playback)> Midiman Flying Cow 24bit/48kHz A/D>RME Digi96/8>Steinberg's Wavelab 3.0 (bit resolution & resampling to 16/44.1>CDWav(v1.71) (tracking only)>Flac Front End
source: Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M (CM - TDK MA-R60 1st set; MA-R90 2nd set)

ai_review.summary: Mixed performance with standout Looks Like Rain and Stella Blue, but hampered by poor Civic Center sound.
ai_review.review: The show has moments that Deadheads love – an electrifying Looks Like Rain and a haunting slide‑laden Stella Blue – yet overall energy is low and the recording suffers from bad acoustics in the Civic Center. While the first set’s song selection was decent, the second set felt over‑played until the Box of Rain encore rescued it.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers gave 4 stars praising specific songs and performance, one gave 2 stars highlighting poor sound; the weighted average of show (≈3.5) and recording quality (≈2) yields a rating around 3.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note bad sound in the Civic Center, likely an audience capture with muddiness and lack of clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set had decent song choices but low energy; second set felt over‑played until the Box of Rain encore, with Looks Like Rain providing a high point.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s slide on Stella Blue creates an eerie feeling that reviewers highlighted.
